summary: Part 4 (18:02-20:26) of the 3.0 Buybox (KAMs) video. Pierre walks the 'Smart Cell x Revibe' Google Sheet: the AE tool price-drop tables, the Payment tool and weekly dated payment tabs (summary totals, claims, extended-warranty refund block), then the Buybox tab, where for some SKUs the Neutral Buybox price equals the Buybox price (the 'lowest conditions' SKUs, which he does not fully explain). All 40 listed frames were opened and checked. Several sentences are cut off in the transcript, so those are logged as unclear rather than stated. The Neutral Buybox columns are hidden in some later frames.
